blockers.description: The combined Home/Collection/health Playwright run passed Home and Collection but health rendered 'Couldn't reach the server.' The isolated health recheck was interrupted before producing a result.
blockers.workaround: Run `npm run e2e -- tests/e2e/health.spec.ts` with fixture backup/restore. If green, repeat the exact Plan 09-08 final gate. If it fails, inspect Rails/Vite startup rather than changing product assertions.

decisions.decision: HOME-02 counts all distinct collection games rather than adding expansion subtype persistence.
decisions.rationale: The user explicitly selected the distinct-game interpretation and kept subtype persistence out of Phase 9.

decisions.decision: Grid is the default view; only list view is serialized in the URL.
decisions.rationale: This keeps default URLs minimal while shared/reloaded links reproduce the selected presentation.

decisions.decision: Game descriptions use Vue text interpolation only and external BGG links use persisted objectid with opener isolation.
decisions.rationale: This satisfies the rich-card contract without exposing raw BGG markup or unsafe new-tab behavior.

decisions.decision: BGG hot data is seeded into the shared test cache for deterministic browser tests.
decisions.rationale: The live BGG API is unsuitable for a deterministic E2E gate.
